attchmntText: CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Computation of cost of acquisition per equity share of CESC Limited, RP-SG Retail Limited and RP-SG Business Process Services Limited'.
CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Annual General Meeting to be held on December 21, 2018

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange that  the Register of Members and Share Transfer Books of the Company shall remain closed from December 14, 2018 to December 21, 2018 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of Annual General Meeting of the Company scheduled to be held on December 21, 2018.
CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Annual General Meeting to be held on December 21, 2018

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Further to our letter SEC:31351 dated 14 November, 2018, we enclose, in terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015, a copy of the Notice dated 14 November, 2018 convening the 40th Annual General Meeting of the Company on 21 December, 2018 at Kolkata.'.
CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Further to our letter No. SEC:12365 and 12366 dated 14 November, 2018, please find enclosed copies of newspaper publications as published today in all the editions of Business Standard, Financial Express, Business Line, Mint and Aajkal in English language.'.
CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Investor Presentation

Further to our letter SEC:12365 of even date attached is an extract of the Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the year ended 31 March,2018 being sent for publication to the press.In accordance with the requisite approval obtained, the Fortieth Annual General Meeting of the members of the Company will be held on Friday, 21 December, 2018 at CITY CENTRE, Royal Bengal Room, DC Block, Sector-I, Salt Lake ,Kolkata-700 064.
CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on November 14, 2018.
CESC Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2018.

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Further to our letter No. SEC: 12362 dated 31 October, 2018, please find enclosed a copy of newspaper publication as published today, in Business Standard (all editions) and Aajkal in English language.'.

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as October 31, 2018 for the purpose of determining the eligible shareholders of the Company entitled to receive the said equity shares of RP-SG Retail Limited and RP-SG Business Process Services Limited.

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Further to our letter No. SEC: 12355 dated 12 October, 2018, please find enclosed a copy of newspaper publication as published today, in Business Standard (all editions) and Aajkal.'.
CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 12, 2018, titled "Composite Scheme of Arrangement".

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of outcome of the meeting of the Board of Directors of CESC Limited ("Company") held on 12 October 2018 and disclosures under Regulation 30 the SEBI (Listing Obligations andDisclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, as amended.'.

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'We enclose a copy of an advertisement as published today in Business Standard and Aajkal, in respect of a notice to the shareholders in relation to transfer of equity shares to Investors Education and Protection Fund.'.

Significant increase in volume has been observed in CESC Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. CESC Limited has submitted their response.

The response from the company is awaited.

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange that This is to inform you that the Registrar of Companies, Kolkata has approved an extension of time for holding the Fortieth Annual General Meeting of the Company by a period of three months i.e. upto December 31, 2018 for the financial year ended on March 31, 2018.
